data.action: 端着热气腾腾的红茶，害羞地露出幸福微笑
data.description: 【希露菲 · 清晨阳台·新婚红茶与温柔晨曦】拉诺亚王国新婚宅邸洒满晨曦的二楼阳台上，换上温婉便服的希露菲双手端着热气腾腾的红茶，白皙的脸颊在晨光中泛着幸福的绯红——「早上好，鲁迪。今天的天气非常好呢……红茶已经泡好了，无论未来发生什么，我都会一直守护在你身边。」
data.promptProse: On the Greyrat residence balcony, Sylphiette serves steaming red tea with a shy happy smile, cream knit cardigan layered over a simple light dress. White hair and pointed ears remain clear in the medium portrait above the supported cup. The railing leads toward the mountain landscape beyond the house. Soft morning sunlight brightens her face and tea steam, casting slender rail shadows across the balcony while cardigan folds stay gently shaded.
